messages:
Maya Patel: FYI the RCA for last night's GPU OOM cascade is live: https://redwood.atlassian.com/RCA-2173. Short summary: KV-cache TTL bug + aggressive scale-down hysteresis absence -> mass evictions -> autoscaler thrash -> latency spike for a subset of customers. No PII exposed. Please read Actions and Owners.

Diego Ramos: Link opens fine. Skimming: proposed actions look right. My suggested priority order: 1) hotfix KV-cache TTL bug (Alex), 2) add autoscaler hysteresis + longer cool-down (Sasha), 3) integration test that simulates KV pressure and eviction (Diego). Recommend 14-day validation checkpoint.

Alex Chen: I9ll take the KV-cache TTL hotfix. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4338. Needs eng-runtime + eng-ml review for perf impact. Targeting hotfix rollout Tue 04/07 EOD PT.

Sasha Ivanov: I9ll implement the autoscaler changes: increase scale-down cool-down to 120s and add a sustained-eviction threshold before scaling in. Canary to 5% traffic first, then 25%. Coordinating with eng-infra for node reservations. Planning canary Wed 04/08 09:00 PT.

Diego Ramos: I9ll add a synthetic regression test to ci/scale-suite to simulate a KV-cache leak pattern and assert eviction < 200/min. Also proposing an alert: eviction-rate > 800/min sustained for 5m => page eng-sre.

Oncall Bot: Incident summary posted to #incidents. Key metrics snapshot: p95 latency rose to ~490ms (baseline ~110ms), eviction-rate peaked ~1.5k/min for 18m. Affected orgs: 9. No data loss reported.

Maya Patel: Thanks. I added explicit owners + due dates to the RCA action checklist. Please update the checklist with short status notes as you progress. We9ll have a 14-day checkpoint sync on Fri 04/17 11:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent). If you can9t attend, add notes to the doc. React with :white_check_mark: when you ack the item.

Alex Chen: Ack :white_check_mark: 33 I9ll paste the PR link and rollout timeline into the RCA once reviews pass.

Sasha Ivanov: Ack :white_check_mark: 33 will post canary telemetry dashboards and update the RCA with rollout steps.

Diego Ramos: Ack :white_check_mark: 33 adding the synthetic test + alert rule to the tracker now.

Maya Patel: Great. Quick ask: if your work uncovers other potential regressions, add them under "Related Findings" in the doc so we can triage during the checkpoint.

Oncall Bot: Reminder created: 14-day checkpoint in 14 days.

Maya Patel: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Will publish a short follow-up after the checkpoint with final owners and closure status.
